newsitem.title: UK: Strong sterling hits LIFFE grains market.
newsitem.headline: Strong sterling hits LIFFE grains market.

text.p: LIFFE grains eased on Tuesday but losses were limited as good market sentiment fought off the effects of a strong sterling.
Traders felt the underlying tone of the market outweighed the effects of the currency. "The market's still friendly," one said.
With sterling at over 2.76 against the mark, "it should have gone down a lot more," he said.
Active May wheat last traded at 99.80 stg, down 0.30 stg. May volume was 428 lots of a total 740.
November was the most active month on barley, with 15 lots of a total 30 traded. It last changed hands unchanged at 93.50 stg.
